}}The '''2017 Chilean Population and Housing Census''' ({{Langx|es|Censo Chileno de Población y Vivienda 2017}}), officially the '''XIX National Population Census and VIII Housing Census''' ({{Langx|es|XIX Censo Nacional de Población y VIII de Vivienda}}), took place on 19 April 2017, and was organized by the [[National Statistics Institute (Chile)|National Statistics Institute]].

== Census ==
The census took place on 19 April 2017, starting at 08:00 in the morning, and by 10:00 in the morning, according to a joint statement by [[Ministry of Economy, Development, and Tourism (Chile)|Minister of Economy]] [[Luis Felipe Céspedes]] and the director of the [[National Statistics Institute (Chile)|National Statistics Institute]] Ximena Clark, over 75% of local people were entered into the system.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Censo 2017: Pese a algunos retrasos autoridades realizan positivo primer balance - LA TERCERA |url=https://www.latercera.com/noticia/censo-2017-pese-retrasos-autoridades-realizan-positivo-primer-balance/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170422153900/https://www.latercera.com/noticia/censo-2017-pese-retrasos-autoridades-realizan-positivo-primer-balance/ |archive-date=2017-04-22 |access-date=2026-04-20 |work=La Tercera |language=es-ES}}</ref> People who were not censed by the end of the day could fill up the questionnaire either in physical form or via a digital platform in later dates.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-04-20 |title=Balance del Censo: A pesar de "exceso" de censistas hubo sectores que reclamaron no haber sido encuestados |url=https://www.theclinic.cl/2017/04/20/balance-del-censo-pesar-exceso-censistas-hubo-sectores-reclamaron-no-haber-encuestados/ |access-date=2026-04-20 |website=The Clinic |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |newspaper=El Mercurio |date=2017-04-22 |title=Censo 2017: Lanzan plataforma web para viviendas que no fueron encuestadas por falta de moradores |url=https://www.emol.com/noticias/Economia/2017/04/22/855263/Censo-2017-Lanzan-plataforma-web-para-viviendas-que-no-fueron-encuestadas-por-falta-de-moradores.html |access-date=2026-04-20 |language=es}}</ref>

Multiple attacks against census workers were reported in cities like [[Santiago]] and [[Coquimbo]].<ref>{{Cite news |newspaper=El Mercurio |date=2017-04-19 |title=Dos censistas fueron asaltados esta mañana en Santiago y Recoleta |url=https://www.emol.com/noticias/Nacional/2017/04/19/854820/Dos-censistas-han-sido-asaltados-esta-manana-en-Santiago-y-Recoleta.html |access-date=2026-04-20 |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2017-04-19 |title=Voluntario del Censo es asaltado en Tierras Blancas |url=http://www.diarioeldia.cl/policial/voluntario-censo-es-asaltado-en-tierras-blancas |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170420143800/http://www.diarioeldia.cl/policial/voluntario-censo-es-asaltado-en-tierras-blancas |archive-date=2017-04-20 |access-date=2026-04-20 |work=Diario El Día |language=es}}</ref> The most severe of these was an attack against census workers in [[Temucuicui]], where the census was suspended due to the attack.<ref>{{Cite web |last=León |first=F. |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Medrano |first=Claudio |date=2017-04-20 |title=Problemas en la organización y protestas marcan proceso de Censo 2017 |url=https://radio.uchile.cl/2017/04/19/problemas-en-la-organizacion-y-protestas-marcan-proceso-de-censo-2017/ |access-date=2026-04-20 |website=Diario y Radio Universidad Chile |language=es-CL}}</ref> damaged, which caused the National Statistics Institute to consider reconducting the census in the affected communes.<ref>{{Cite news |newspaper=El Mercurio |date=2017-05-16 |title=Aluviones dañan == Questionnaire ==
The census questionnaire consisted of 21 questions among four sections; the ''A section'', which is filled in by the censist and consists of housing identification, the ''B section'', which consists of the data of the housing itself, with the first two questions being filled by the censist, the ''C section'', which consists of two questions identifying the people living in the housing, and the ''D section'', which asks about the personal information of the residents of the housing.<ref>{{Cite news |work=T13 |date=2017-04-18 |title=¿Qué preguntan en el Censo 2017?: esto es lo que deberás responder al encuestador |url=https://www.t13.cl/noticia/nacional/te-puede-servir/censo-2017-las-21-preguntas-que-hara-encuestador-censista |access-date=2026-04-20 |language=es}}</ref>

The census was translated into six languages aside from [[Spanish language|Spanish]]: [[Mapudungun]], [[English language|English]], [[French language|French]], [[German language|German]], [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]] and [[Haitian Creole]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Retamal |first=Rodrigo |date=2017-04-18 |title=Conoce el cuestionario que deberás responder en el Censo |url=https://www.latercera.com/noticia/conoce-cuestionario-deberas-responder-censo/ |access-date=2026-04-20 |website=La Tercera |language=es}}</ref>

== Results ==
In late August 2017, the preliminary results of the census were published, showing a population of 17,574,003 people between 6,499,355 homes (or approximately 2.7 people per home), a 5.6% increase in population since the 2012 census.<ref>{{Cite web |title=WEB DISEMINACIÓN CENSO 2017 WEB DISEMINACIÓN CENSO 2017 |url=http://resultados.censo2017.cl/ |access-date=2026-04-19 |website=resultados.censo2017.cl |archive-date=2018-05-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180513192703/http://resultados.censo2017.cl/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
